definitions.explanation: Describes a person or lifestyle characterized by vigorous activity and energy. Used for people who are always doing things, as well as for lively or dynamic situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{活動的|かつどうてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a very active person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八十歳|はちじゅっさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{活動的|かつどうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather lives actively even past the age of eighty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{活動的|かつどうてき}になって、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: He's become more active since retiring, going to the gym every day.

notes:
USAGE:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (activity) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix making na-adjectives). Used as a modifier with な ({活動的|かつどうてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧) or as a predicate with だ/です. The adverbial form {活動的|かつどうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {活動的|かつどうてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (an active person)
- {活動的|かつどうてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (an active lifestyle)
- {活動的|かつどうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (to spend time actively)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧: proactive, assertive — emphasizes willingness to take initiative
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧: energetic, healthy — more casual and broader in meaning
